Label: Feature
Description: A GeoSPARQL feature; the second type of every Site, County and State node.

Label: Statement
Description: An RDF statement (reified triple). Each OBSERVED_ORGANISM and OBSERVED_AT link has one, carrying the properties of that link.

Label: County
Description: A U.S. county, with FIPS codes, a boundary polygon and, for most, a link to the matching KnowWhereGraph region.

Label: Dataset
Description: A source dataset of observations: iNaturalist exports, and EPA National Rivers and Streams Assessment and USGS BioData surveys obtained through finsyncR.

Label: Family
Description: A taxonomic family; its label is the scientific name.

Label: Genus
Description: A taxonomic genus; its label is the scientific name. Observations not identified to species point to a genus.

Label: Observation
Description: A record of an organism observed or sampled at a site on a date, taken from one of the source datasets.

Label: Order
Description: A taxonomic order; its label is the scientific name.

Label: Site
Description: An observation or sampling site given by its coordinates.

Label: Species
Description: A species; its label is the scientific name (e.g., Campostoma anomalum).

Label: State
Description: A U.S. state or the District of Columbia, with its abbreviation, FIPS code, boundary polygon and KnowWhereGraph region.

Label: Taxonomic Class
Description: A taxonomic class (e.g., Bivalvia, Magnoliopsida); the top rank of the taxonomy in this graph.

Label: Amphibian Name
Description: Represents the scientific or common name of an amphibian species in the KN-Wildlife knowledge network. Part of the older KN-Wildlife layer (wildlife.proto-okn.net namespace), which is separate from the Observation model.

Label: Bird Name
Description: Represents the scientific or common name of a bird species in the KN-Wildlife knowledge network. Part of the older KN-Wildlife layer (wildlife.proto-okn.net namespace), which is separate from the Observation model.

Label: Location
Description: A geographic place or spatial region where wildlife observations occur. Part of the older KN-Wildlife layer (wildlife.proto-okn.net namespace), which is separate from the Observation model.
